reproduction.source_audit: Diagnostic adapters only; model files unchanged. SeparateVO and Mudd native CE replayed against historical runs; noSelf old 2k/12k single-layer deltas independently replayed.

conclusions: Mudd mean tail MHA necessity rises ~4x, especially L32. SeparateVO stays near its early level; therefore low late marginal necessity does not require noSelf masking and is not universal across these architectures.
Truncated noSelf has modest average growth and L31 increases; fullQK stays comparatively flat. Smaller single-layer effects do not imply smaller joint-tail effects.
At20k joint-last5 delta exceeds sum of singles in all four runs. Do not interpret mean or sum as total contribution.

Combined and vector-only scopes differ, especially at L8. Even vector-only tail/L8 evolves oppositely in SeparateVO and Mudd. Scope changes part of the depth contrast, not the whole trajectory difference.

12k projected tail MHA RMS remains comparable. Prior matched-cohort L32 M_o ablations are larger than MHA ablations, supporting alternative readout specialization; this is not an isolated causal explanation for loss-gap shrinkage.
